I am a 57-year-old woman farming in the highlands of Oromia, and this small barley plot of mine is important for feeding my family. I will apply some DAP and urea that I get through the cooperative, and I will also spread whatever cow dung and compost I have managed to collect, because the soil needs help. I will plant the barley seed I saved from my own harvest last year — I do not buy improved seed, and for barley I do not need chemicals or irrigation since the meher rains are usually enough. My children and I will do all the work on this plot ourselves; it is only 0.17 hectares, so we do not need to hire anyone.
